description: The v1 compatibility mapping: preserved legacy behavior versus rejected incomplete features.

mapping.reason: session artifacts v1-v3 are accepted and normalized by the reader
legacy model_type aliases resolve through the alias registry
legacy identity fields map to canonical subject identity
legacy identity fields map to canonical variant identity
time ceilings carry over; minute values convert to seconds
descriptive objective text is preserved verbatim; metric semantics come from the skill metric declaration
nonsecret parameters migrate; credential-shaped keys must already use secret references
continuation guidance is preserved through restart
the skill's metric declaration yields the objective policy
existing manifest digests remain provenance evidence

mapping.legacy_field: tag / quick_mode / hpo / legacy provenance sections
mapping.reason: retained on their existing session surfaces as-is; no v1 contract field, so migration neither maps nor drops them
nonce-echo self-verification is an incomplete trust feature; verified results require an evaluator receipt, and legacy self-claims migrate as unverified_imported at best
experiment-tracking integration was never implemented; accepting the field would promise inert behavior
